source: his 2026-11-12 15:00 "sure" to finishing OT-24: the qst13 look (a live ship in its own faction, same-faction escorts, that faction's crew), bd1 with only the look changed
_note: BOARDING PROBE BD2 (plan OT-24): the qst13 LIVE look. bd1's ship, NOT derelict and NOT dark, a Crimson crew aboard, 1 to 3 Crimson escorts. Silent, placeholder words. Not a mission.

Reading it: take it, go to the system. The ship and its escorts are there and fighting; HE disables it (engines down) without destroying it, then docks and boards. Destroying it before boarding fails the mission ([board] stage 90), as vanilla.
Inside: gravity rolled, lights ON, a Crimson crew, the item at one of their spots. Pick it up: complete, pays easy.
